concerns.text: Spec FR-006 mandates Benjamini-Hochberg (FDR) as the default multiple-comparison correction. Task T027 implements only 'permutation-based FDR'. No task exists to implement the spec-mandated Benjamini-Hochberg method as the default or to provide a fallback, leaving FR-006 unimplemented.

Spec FR-003 requires KS tests against the 'theoretical' Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution. Task T025 explicitly implements a 'parameterized' MB distribution (Lilliefors correction) where T is derived from the sample. No task exists to implement the strict theoretical KS test required by the spec, creating a gap in FR-003 coverage.

Spec FR-005 requires sensitivity analysis on 'discrepancy boundaries' to report robustness of rejection decisions. Task T033 sweeps 'energy-ratio boundaries' to measure 'quasi-thermal' classification stability. No task explicitly sweeps discrepancy boundaries to verify the stability of the null hypothesis rejection decision (True/False) as required by FR-005 and SC-003.

Plan 'Core Metric Update' defines 'Degrees-of-Freedom Normalized Energy Ratio' as the primary quantification metric. While T025a calculates it, no task is explicitly scoped to 'Calculate DOF-Normalized Energy Ratio' as a distinct deliverable for the primary hypothesis test, creating ambiguity in traceability to the Plan's specific metric definition.

Task T084 is marked as 'Polish' but addresses a critical audit requirement ('State the exact streaming/sampling rule') mandated by the Constitution and Plan. Deferring this to 'Polish' risks the implementation failing the 'Verified Accuracy' or 'Reproducibility' gates if the metadata is incomplete.
